name: Use case or proposal
about: Describe a monitoring need or a focused improvement before implementation.
title: ''
---

## Need

Who would use this, what are they trying to find, and how do they handle it today?

## Desired result

Describe the visible outcome and what would show that it is useful.

## Examples and boundaries

Provide synthetic examples that should and should not be selected. Describe source type and access requirements without posting private source content or account details.

## Alternatives and open questions

What existing behavior or simpler approach could solve the problem? Which decisions are still needed?
